source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chromosome structure (PDF 116).

blocks.text: Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic cells mein chromosomes ki banawat aur kimiyai tarkeeb (chemical composition) mukhtalif hai; yeh hissa eukaryotic cells ke chromosomes ke baare mein hai.

Chromosomes patle, dhage jaise dhaanche hain jo DNA aur histone proteins se bane hain. In ki tadaad aur shakal har species mein mukhtalif hai, aur poora set karyotype kehlata hai. Diploid jandaron ke jismani (somatic) cells mein chromosomes joron mein hote hain, yaani homologous chromosomes; gametes mein aadhi tadaad hoti hai, joron mein nahi.

Jab cell taqseem nahi ho raha (interphase) to us ke chromosomes alag dhaanchon ki tarah nazar nahi aate: woh khule hue aik bareek jaal, chromatin, ki shakal mein rehte hain. Jab cell taqseem ki tayyari karta hai to DNA histones ki chhoti ikaiyon ke gird lipat'ta, yeh ikaiyan mazeed lipat'ti hain, aur zyada lipatne aur sukarne se dhaancha mota aur chhota ho kar aakhir mein ghane dhage jaise chromosomes ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Chromatin kya hai, aur chromosomes kab nazar aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Chromatin taqseem na hone wale (interphase) nucleus mein DNA aur histones ka bareek, khula jaal hai. Chromosomes tab nazar aate hain jab cell taqseem ki tayyari mein chromatin ko lapet'ta aur sukarta hai.

items: Chromosomes: DNA + histones; poora set karyotype.
Somatic cells: homologous jore; gametes: aadhi tadaad.
Interphase: chromatin; taqseem: lipte, sukre chromosomes.
